name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
description: UNESCO World Heritage church holding the relics of St. Francis Xavier, a key historic landmark.

name: Fort Aguada
description: 17th-century Portuguese fort with a lighthouse and views over the Arabian Sea, close to Candolim.

name: Se Cathedral
description: One of the largest churches in Asia, notable for its Portuguese-Gothic architecture.

name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
description: A four-tiered waterfall inside Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary, usually visited via jeep safari.

name: Goa State Museum
description: Exhibits on Goan history, art and Portuguese-era artefacts, a good indoor option in bad weather.

name: Chorla Ghats Viewpoint
description: Misty viewpoint on the Western Ghats border, popular for photography and quiet nature time.
